title: Group scrambled SKUs
description:
A warehouse scanner sometimes reads the characters of a product code in the wrong order, so `"ab12"` and `"2a1b"` are the same product.

Write `group_skus(codes)` that groups together the codes that use exactly the same characters the same number of times.

Return a list of groups. Sort the codes inside each group, then sort the groups by their first code.

**Example**

```
group_skus(["ab12", "x9", "2a1b", "9x", "zz"])
# [["2a1b", "ab12"], ["9x", "x9"], ["zz"]]
```
hints: Two codes belong together when their sorted characters are equal.
Use the sorted characters, joined into a string or as a tuple, as a dictionary key.
Sort each group, then sort the list of groups. Lists compare element by element.
